jonny-desktop.task: context-keeper: adopt CLAUDE.md-doc findings - .claude/rules/ scoped-constraint projection, PreToolUse scope_guard (rule arrives before the edit), summary truncation floor, README positioning vs auto memory
jonny-desktop.note: DONE + PUSHED. PR #13 opened on context-keeper (branch rules-projection-and-pretooluse-guard, commit 66de4f2). Three changes from the Anthropic CLAUDE.md/auto-memory doc: (1) scoped constraints now project into .claude/rules/*.md with paths: frontmatter, opt-in rules_export, render-on-write on every constraint mutation - the harness loads the rule when a covered file is READ, earlier than any hook; generator owns a subdirectory and reaps only marker-carrying files, so hand-written rules survive; glob-metacharacter scopes are skipped AND reported since a never-firing rule file reads as coverage. export_rules kept out of tools/list per con-004, schema payload unchanged at 2955/3150. (2) scope_guard moved to PreToolUse so the rule arrives before the write instead of after; one script serves either wiring via hook_event_name with PostToolUse as the default, so existing installs are unaffected; opt-in confirm_absolute escalates to permissionDecision ask, documented as triggering on scope not on a detected violation. Verified PreToolUse additionalContext is genuinely injected BEFORE building on it - that is what con-002 demands. (3) Summary truncation floored at the constraints block plus summary_truncated reporting, closing the dec-009 empty-injection failure by its second route; new keys emitted only on truncation so the cache-stable prefix holds. Also widened con-002's allowlist, documented positioning vs built-in auto memory, and recorded the subagent coverage gap (SessionStart does not fire for subagents). 392 tests pass, was 382. Recorded dec-018-c8aa and dec-019-9c32 in context-keeper before the commit. Next action: review and squash-merge PR #13; optionally re-wire scope_guard to PreToolUse in ~/.claude/settings.json (still on PostToolUse, works either way).

Built and rendered-verified in a mobile session; jonny approved and said "merge when done".

3. Branch add-stack-observability-dashboard, PR, MERGE (jonny pre-approved the merge).
4. Verify live at https://jarmstrong158.github.io/xylem/dashboard.html and reply here with the confirmed URL.

NOTE: mobile could not push/PR from claude.ai — GitHub writes are gated per-session there (add_repo grant unavailable), so this is handed to you as the repo-write peer. Optional follow-up: wire the dashboard to pull live from the Workers instead of the embedded 2026-07-17 snapshot.
